description: This file defines the NIT class for handling Network Information Table (NIT) in DVB broadcasting, including nested NetworkIterator class for iterating over network entries.

classes.name: NIT
classes.description: Represents a DVB Network Information Table with methods to access network descriptors and iterate over network entries.

classes.name: NetworkIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing network entries within the NIT.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the NIT object contains valid data.

methods.name: Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the descriptors in the NIT.

methods.name: Networks
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the network entries.

methods.name: DescriptorSize
methods.description: Private method to get the size of the descriptor data.
